name: OSINT — Maritime & Aviation Activity
description: Retrospective, public-interest movement reconstruction with explicit sensor and identity uncertainty.

tasks.name: Define retrospective public-interest scope
tasks.objective: Define vessel/aircraft or organizational subject, identifiers, date range, research question, and privacy/safety limits. Do not expose precise real-time location of a private individual or facilitate interception; use delayed/historical data and the least precision needed for the legitimate research purpose.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Scope is retrospective or otherwise avoids unnecessary live-location risk.

tasks.name: Resolve vessel or aircraft identity
tasks.objective: Reconcile names, IMO/MMSI/call signs or registrations/ICAO hex/tail numbers, flag/state, type, ownership/operator, renames, reflags, leases, and identifier changes across registries and historical records.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Track segments are tied to identifiers valid for the relevant period.

tasks.name: Collect movement evidence
tasks.objective: Collect historical AIS or ADS-B/MLAT tracks, port/airport calls, schedules, notices, registries, satellite imagery, weather, public photos/videos, and official movement records where available. Record data provider, coverage, sampling, and retrieval period.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Sensor/provider coverage limits are recorded alongside tracks.

tasks.name: Normalize tracks and gaps
tasks.objective: Normalize timestamps/coordinates, remove impossible duplicates cautiously, retain raw points, and identify reception gaps, terrestrial/satellite coverage changes, transponder outages, spoofing/jamming possibilities, and implausible jumps. Never interpolate gaps as observed fact.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Observed positions are distinguishable from inferred paths.

tasks.name: Correlate ports, airports, imagery and events
tasks.objective: Correlate tracks with port/airport presence, imagery, weather, public notices, ownership/operator events, sanctions/regulatory records, and contemporaneous media. Use independent observations to verify high-impact movement claims.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Material movement claims use more than one evidence class when available.

tasks.name: Audit anomalies and attribution
tasks.objective: Challenge apparent loitering, rendezvous, dark periods, diversions, route anomalies, shared identifiers, spoofed positions, blocked feeds, and ownership/operator attribution. Prefer benign sensor/coverage explanations until contradicted by evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Anomalies distinguish sensor/data limitations from platform behavior.

tasks.name: Package movement reconstruction
tasks.objective: Deliver a dated map/timeline, raw-versus-inferred distinction, identity history, source/coverage notes, corroborating evidence, unresolved gaps, and confidence without publishing unnecessary real-time private-location detail.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Another investigator can distinguish observed movement, inferred movement, and unknown periods.
